text: 7月16日，率中国党政代表团对朝鲜进行正式友好访问的中共中央政治局常委、全国政协主席王沪宁在平壤同朝鲜劳动党中央政治局常委、国务委员会副委员长、内阁总理朴泰成共同出席《中朝友好合作互助条约》签订65周年纪念招待会并致辞。（新华社）
text_en: On July 16, Wang Huning, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, who is leading a Chinese party and government delegation on an official goodwill visit to North Korea, attended a commemorative reception in Pyongyang with Pak Thae-song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Workers' Party of Korea Central Committee, vice chairman of the State Affairs Commission, and premier of the Cabinet, to mark the 65th anniversary of the signing of the China-North Korea Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance. (Xinhua News Agency)
